text: Being here, I feel a curious sense of anticipation. The first scene—with its glass-walled, quiet meeting room—conjures thoughts about the spaces where ideas germinate in silence before entering the world. The second space, bursting with color and devoted to research and development, radiates energy and possibility. Surrounded by the urge to discover, I feel compelled to reflect on the human drive for progress and the environments that foster it. There is excitement, but also a faint undercurrent of pressure—so much potential asks: how will we use it?
